notes.title: Three Kingdoms 16.03 STEAM version is now available~🎉
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45014714/353db17b5a32a69fa8ef52d954335fb80399db2e.gif


Three Kingdoms 16.03 STEAM version is now available~🎉

This update brings new content, as well as exciting new generals joining the battlefield and the STEAM exclusive server that the protagonists are looking forward to.

📢The new 95 server will have a 95 server ownership event. The detailed event content will be officially announced on 9/12 (Thursday). Lords, please look forward to it🎊

[New content in version]
1. New server: Server 95, officially opened at 11:00 on 9/12 (Thursday)
2. New general: Lu Lingqi
3. Newly added Soul Contract generals: Fengzi Cao Zhi, Dragon Fury Guan Yu
4. New images of military commanders: Guo Jia, Pang Tong, Jia Xu
5. Added new battle order image: Jia Fu
6. Newly added destiny: Level 120 destiny skill: Sword Guard
7. Added new star map: Star Map: Taotie

[Version optimization content]
1. System optimization: marching function optimization
2. Optimize some system functions

※Reminder: If STEAM does not update automatically, please log in to STEAM again and update the latest version. Using the old version may cause the star chart system to be abnormal or crash.

🎊 Celebrate the upcoming launch of "一統天下 THREE KINGDOMS" on the Steam platform!

The battle among warlords resumes—invite friends to conquer together for another decade!
Pre-registration is now open with rewards for everyone!

🌟 Complete the following steps to receive "MyCard 100 Points" by adding "Unified Under Heaven" to your Steam wishlist:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45014714/5f69616926bd02f16221072cb72236f898de0831.gif
📌 How to participate:

1. Go to the Steam Store and add "一統天下 THREE KINGDOMS" to your wishlist.

2. Click to {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45014714/922138c731863dc91139208d816dd0496c5b7cf8.png

3. Like and comment on the event post with:
#ReserveTheGloryAgain and get MyCard 100 Points!

4. Tag a friend.
After completing, message the admin with a screenshot of your Steam wishlist including your Steam account name.
By pre-registering, you'll also receive a "Steam Exclusive Gift Pack":
✨ Selectable Normal General Chest A *1, 500 Gold Coins, 500 Recruitment Orders, and 2 million provisions. (Valued over NTD 2,000)

Additionally, if this post reaches 500 comments, a server-wide reward will be distributed:
✨ 500 Gold Coins, 300 Recruitment Orders, and 2 million provisions. ✨

⚡ Event Duration:
From now until 31st July 23:59 (UTC).

🎁 Pre-registration rewards:
MyCard 100 Points (limited to the first 1000 participants)

Notes:

1. Each Steam account can only claim rewards once. Using screenshots from others will not grant rewards.
2. Participants who fail to message the admin with the required screenshot after the event will not receive the rewards.
3. For any questions about the event, please contact customer service or the official fan page.
4. The organizers reserve the right to modify or terminate the event period, content, rewards, etc., and their decisions will be final.
